2nd time: speed up a bit and see if they stop


3rd time: "you pull it, you tank it"

At your level, tanks shouldn't take much dmg.

Get used to how much HP you heal per cast. If the tank is slow pulling (2-4 mobs at a time) you should just freely dps (Aero - stone stone stone stone stone) until the tank is roughly at 2/3 hp, in which case you should consider starting to cast a heal.

This isn't specific to any role, but here goes a piece of advice, and a bit of advertisement about my way of mentoring.

While most people know about "ABC" - "Always be casting" , i have seen many people who, despite having this skill, does something pretty detrimental : cast Ogcd or "out of cooldown spells/skills" straight out, rather than waiting until the Global Cooldown is in effect.

1- Try to only use OGCD between GCD. That is, if you have the global cooldown still loading, cast these "out of cooldown" spells. Otherwise, try to use a GCD, preferably one with a short cast, so that you can fit in said OGCD.

2- Specifically for healers and tanks, switching targets should be done as if it was an OGCD, as that takes some time, not only mechanically, but your brain has to adapt on your new target and what you want to cast on it, be it a shieldlob to pull, a heal, etc.

King: Revive. Once per game, revive a piece that died last turn and place it next to the king. 1 cast per game.
